summary: Answer a bucketless replication request whose listing does not reproduce its digest with bounded range proofs instead of the full identity inventory

replay.detail: Existing replicated records retain their interpretation and replay order.

schema.detail: No durable schema or replicated record format changes.

rules.detail: A request without range digests whose listed identities do not reproduce its digest is treated as omitting its range proofs, as a marked root probe is: it receives bounded range listings and no envelopes it does not provably lack. Requests with no digest, or with a complete listing, still receive the complete inventory and are still counted in the full-inventory answer total.

compatibility.detail: A root probe whose markers were dropped on the way, such as one sent before capability negotiation to a peer, relay or replication worker that does not read capabilities, now gets a range answer that fits one exchange instead of a full listing refused as replication-exchange-metadata-too-large. Peers that send range digests or complete listings see no change. The full-inventory warning now names only complete listings.

downtime.detail: No fleet-wide simultaneous upgrade or data migration is required. Upgrade a node's daemon and replication worker together so the worker keeps request capabilities.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; ordinary binary rollback applies.
